behavior: Status distinguishes stopped, starting, destination-failed, healthy and unowned states with error/why/fix and no credential values.
The first start records a safe descriptor and returns only after READY plus destination health; a second healthy start spawns no duplicate.
Stop acts only on the exact owned process identity, is idempotent when absent and refuses stale or reused PID state.
State and bounded logs live below the per-user dotf state directory and work through Windows and POSIX process seams.
Copilot App stale origin identity is recovered by remove/re-add after bridge health, never by writing its internal database.
